      35.2
               Correct the errors in this paragraph. There are seven in total. Each error is a matter of either an
               extra word or wrong word order.
               Hannah and  Ben were playing a game. Hannah had thought of a famous football player and Ben
               was trying to find who it was out. He turned his mother to but she pointed it out that she knew
               absolutely nothing about football. He would have to try to track the answer himself down and to
               watch out any clues for that Hannah might deliberately give. After ten minutes Ben still hadn’t
               latched up on to who she was talking about, so he gave himself up and Hannah told him the answer.
